company.name: Scout Security
company.shortDescription: Scout Security is a home security system that combines hardware designs and easy-to-use controls.
company.description:
Scout is a home security system that combines hardware designs and easy-to-use controls. It enables its users to access the device from anywhere on their phones, tablets, or computers.

The company's monitoring technology gives its users peace of mind at home and away. It also allows its users to customize their responses to all alerts.


Scout was founded in 2012 in Chicago, Illinois.
